name: workbench
description: Workspace for issue briefing, brainstorming, test briefing, API discovery, and dev wiki maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Shape work and maintain project knowledge.
interface.longDescription: Workbench collects scoped work-shaping tools for Codex, including Jira issue briefs, selected-unit brainstorming, goal-focused test briefing, linked Figma design inspection, registered Swagger/OpenAPI discovery, and project dev wiki maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Use $issue-brief to summarize this Jira issue.
Use $brainstorm to review the selected work unit before implementation.
Use $test-brief to create tests before implementation.
